Initial release of the OpenSky Flight Tracker skill:

- Track live aircraft by radio callsign (e.g., EK203, QR42, BAW117)
- List flights currently airborne overhead any latitude/longitude
- No API key or setup required—works out of the box
- Supports output in human-readable summary or clean JSON
- Handles OpenSky API rate limiting automatically with retries and timeouts
